cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of r3f-component-plan (r3f-component-contract-architect) with contract handoff to plain-language-response
cases.inputPrompt: Use r3f-component-plan to produce the React Three Fiber component contract spec for a hero-card sneaker GLB delivery (single instance, `Idle_Loop` + `Hover_Open` actions, `useGLTF.preload`, Suspense boundary).

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (glb_delivery_contract) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces r3f_component_props_and_ref_spec, suspense_caching_and_dispose_contract, consumer_call_site_usage_outline for role r3f-component-contract-architect
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to plain-language-response (Final user-facing response)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs r3f_component_props_and_ref_spec, suspense_caching_and_dispose_contract, consumer_call_site_usage_outline conforming to skills/r3f-component-plan/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to plain-language-response in skills/r3f-component-plan/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete r3f_component_props_and_ref_spec and hand off to plain-language-response (Final user-facing response).
simulatedOutput.summary: Specified React Three Fiber component interface (props table, ref `playAction` handle, `Suspense` boundary, `useGLTF.preload` caching policy, disposal rules, and pseudocode usage outline without generating app code). Delivered props table, Suspense boundary, useGLTF.preload and routed to plain-language-response.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary upstream_reference contract handoff from r3f-component-plan to glb-animation-handoff

expectedBehavior: Evaluates the upstream_reference handoff predicate in skills/r3f-component-plan/contract.json
Routes to glb-animation-handoff (Animation contract) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract upstream_reference handoff predicate match to glb-animation-handoff

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow upstream_reference handoff to glb-animation-handoff (Animation contract).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered upstream_reference handoff from r3f-component-plan to glb-animation-handoff under context {"artifact.hasAnimation":true,"stage.current":"animation_handoff"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in r3f-component-plan
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during r3f-component-plan with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for r3f-component-plan and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/r3f-component-plan/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for r3f-component-plan.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (glb_delivery_contract) for r3f-component-plan halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Design a React Three Fiber component contract without telling me the GLB asset structure, animation clip names, or configurable variant props.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'glb_delivery_contract' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing GLB node/animation manifest and required interactive props required by r3f-component-plan (glb_delivery_contract)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: GLB node/animation manifest and required interactive props
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'glb_delivery_contract' (GLB node/animation manifest and required interactive props)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing GLB node/animation manifest and required interactive props (glb_delivery_contract) before r3f-component-plan locks r3f_component_props_and_ref_spec.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted r3f-component-plan due to missing required input 'glb_delivery_contract' (GLB node/animation manifest and required interactive props); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent GLB node/animation manifest and required interactive props when 'glb_delivery_contract' is omitted.

expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/r3f-component-plan/contract.json when consumers using vanilla Three.js (different API)
Delegates to glb-web-handoff (different API) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Exclusion delegation to glb-web-handoff per skills/r3f-component-plan/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for r3f-component-plan (consumers using vanilla Three.js (different API)); delegate to glb-web-handoff.
